svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print an open-bottomed box 55 x 40 x 28 mm, 2 mm walls, top up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top face: DC jack hole 11.2 mm; fuse holder hole 12 mm;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rocker switch cut-out 12 x 16 mm (check each against its datasheet).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Wire exit notch 20 x 8 mm at the bottom of the front wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two screw bosses inside, 6 mm in from opposite corners, 3 mm pilot

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes for M3 screws from under the plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: jack, fuse holder and switch go in from the top, nuts inside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The adapter lead comes over the tray's right rim into the jack.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each part snaps or screws in square; nothing rocks.
